title: Verify real-time subscriptions for reactions & replies

context_files.reason: Async patterns, error handling in subscriptions

acceptance_criteria: Verify Supabase realtime is enabled on forum_posts and forum_post_reactions tables
Verify ForumTopicPage post INSERT subscription works: new posts appear without page refresh
Verify ForumTopicPage reaction subscription works: reaction counts update in real-time
Verify post DELETE subscription removes posts from view
Fix any subscription issues: check channel names, filter correctness, cleanup on unmount
Add error handling to subscription callbacks (log errors, don't crash)
Reactions: optimistic update still works correctly alongside realtime sync (no double-counting)
No console errors related to subscription cleanup on page navigation
